name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
steps: Lie on your side with your head supported, hips stacked and top leg straight.
Bend your bottom knee slightly for balance and rest your top hand lightly on the floor in front of you.
Keeping your toes forward, lift your top leg only as far as your pelvis stays still.
Lower your leg slowly back down just short of resting on the bottom leg, and switch sides after completing one leg.
tips: Do not roll your top hip backward or turn your toes up toward the ceiling, which shifts work to the hip flexors.
Lead with your heel and keep your leg in line with your torso.
